_note: Summaries are drafts to edit. Keywords decide which papers appear under each theme (matched in title, abstract and keywords).

themes.name: Genomic prediction and breeding design
themes.summary: How genomic and phenotypic information can be combined to predict genetic merit, and how breeding programmes can be designed to turn those predictions into sustained genetic gain.

themes.name: Inbreeding and genetic diversity
themes.summary: Measuring inbreeding and diversity from genomic data, understanding inbreeding depression, and managing selection so that populations keep the variation they will need.

themes.name: Host genome and microbiome
themes.summary: The interplay between an animal's genome and the microbial communities it carries, and what that interplay means for efficiency, health and resilience.

themes.name: Functional genomics and multi-omics
themes.summary: Linking genetic variation to its biological consequences through mapping, transcriptomic, epigenomic and metabolomic data.

themes.name: Quantitative genetics of complex traits
themes.summary: Genetic parameters, genotype-by-environment interaction and the genetic architecture of production, health, fertility and resilience traits.

themes.name: Statistical and computational methods
themes.summary: Statistical models, simulation and machine-learning tools developed to answer the questions above at scale.
